text_to_image_prompt: Create an environment-only 三维图 for 公寓楼外立面与外台阶. Refined muted ivory, sage, blue-grey and warm wood technical spatial diagram. One axonometric cutaway, hide roof and lower near walls for visibility. No people, animals, character reflections, advertising or invented real-world measurements. This is a concept set-design reconstruction; inferred dimensions and hidden areas remain explicitly marked as proposals. Text-to-image wording is reconstructed documentation, not the original production tool input.
